interlocking._about: Signals by their #A number (as on the map in admin mode). groups: only one signal of a group shows via libera at a time. manual: depot signals worked by the player (red until clicked, unless the depot is on automatic).

groups.name: San Donato: uscita deposito e tronchetti
Anello di prova: rossi, verdi solo per il treno che entra o esce
Ingresso deposito da w71/w72: due treni paralleli, passa uno alla volta

interlocking._manual_about: #A02 (from the depot towards the line, up to #A06) and #A04 (from the line into the depot): legal direction. #A03 and #A05: wrong direction. All red until the player clears them, unless the depot is on automatic.

depot_sides._about: Shunting signals east and west of this longitude: one movement at a time on each side

zones.name: anello di prova
zones._about: one train at a time on the test loop: #A94 clears only for the train holding it (it asks by radio at #A94)

interlocking._model: One model: groups (one signal at a time; hold = the grant stays until the movement is over; section = block section to the next signal), manual (worked by the player when the depot is on manual; all shunting signals are manual too), depot_sides (shunting signals east/west of lon: one movement at a time per side), zones (one train at a time, entry signals). Signals by their fixed #A number.

names._about: Names of tracks by OSM way (w number in the editor). Shown on the map and used by the radio.

depot_unused._about: No unused depot places any more: the places after #A76 (train 28), #A77 and #A78 are given only when nothing else is free (Giovanni, 28 Oct)

avoid_ways._about: w71 east of the red line: wrong way only out of the depot (heading 50); into the depot by #A04-#A98 it is the preferred way (Giovanni, 28 Oct) | w72 east of the red line into the depot: a small extra so that trains coming in take #A04-#A98 (w71) and leave the w72 track (#A99) free for the trains going out

removed_signals_about: #A42 (exit from the depot towards the station): Giovanni, it protects nothing (28 Oct). Numbers of the others do not change. #A43 duplicate of #A07 (28 Oct).

depot_through._about: Tracks through the depot building (OSM node pairs joined across the building). Fixed (Giovanni, 28 Oct): the build no longer looks for them. Their order matters: flags on them refer to it (w -1 is the first).
depot_through._fix: 28 Oct, Giovanni: inside the building #A79 joins #A48 (w36-w21), #A80 #A49 (w38-w20), #A81 #A50 (w39-w22); w33 (#A78) ends like w32 and w34

loop_turn.name: Girare per andare anello di prova
loop_turn.note: punto non fisico: qui cambiano banco i treni del lato A48-A65 diretti all'anello

_signal_numbers: Every signal keeps its number 'n' (#A..): removing one leaves a gap, a new one gets the next free number.

loop_wait.name: Muso treni che aspettano di entrare nell'anello

loop_exit_stop.name: Dove si ferma il muso di coda dei treni che escono dall'anello

avoid_signals._about: Giovanni 28 Oct: #A60 eastbound and #A91 westbound are the usual way; #A61 and #A92 are used only when convenient (the one-way tracks are a preference, not a ban). Cost added to the track under the signal, in its direction.

depot_places_add._about: Dead ends that are depot places even if their last piece is a little short. 200002: the track behind #A73 (w0).

loop_exit_a94._about: Giovanni 28 Oct: from beyond #A95 these places cannot be reached; a train given one of them leaves the test loop back through #A94 (only if no train waits at #A94).

tail_slots._about: Giovanni 28 Oct: the Comasina tails hold three trains each at the end of service (110 m a position: the new trains are 108 m, the old ones 105 m, couplers not counted). The tail track, from its dead end to the switch, is made 3 x 110 m long (the dead end moves); the first position is the deepest, centred 55 m from the end. Signals sit between the positions (one each way, at 110 m and 220 m from the end).

block_numbers_about: Fixed #A numbers of the block signals computed along the line (key: direction|kind|name -> number). A block keeps its number when others are added or removed; a new block gets the next free number (the build prints it). #A201-#A289 are the numbers the page showed before they were frozen.
signal_types_about: stype: a station protection, b station + switch protection, c departure, d departure with a switch ahead, e terminus departure, f San Donato entry. legal: the normal direction of the track (right-hand); wrong-way signals are normally red.
